title: A moving guided phase imposes a necessary dimension on a fixed collective subspace
statement: For u_j(q)=exp(i*(j-(N-1)/2)*q)/sqrt(N), a fixed orthogonal rank-r projector P with sup_I||(I-P)u(q)||<=epsilon,0<W=|I|<=2pi, obeys r>=(1-epsilon^2)*N*W/(2pi). Also sum of the top-r eigenvalues of C_I>=1-epsilon^2, where C_jl=exp(i*(j-l)*q_center)*sinc((j-l)*W/2)/N. These are necessary uniform-approximation conditions.

requires: Normalized equally spaced phase vector; one fixed orthogonal projection P across the whole supplied interval,0<W<=2pi.
Uniform amplitude residual target; use validated grid inputs and M>=2 for the conditional continuous upper bound.
provides: For u_j(q)=exp(i*(j-(N-1)/2)*q)/sqrt(N), a fixed orthogonal rank-r projector P with sup_I||(I-P)u(q)||<=epsilon,0<W=|I|<=2pi, obeys r>=(1-epsilon^2)*N*W/(2pi). Also sum of the top-r eigenvalues of C_I>=1-epsilon^2, where C_jl=exp(i*(j-l)*q_center)*sinc((j-l)*W/2)/N. These are necessary uniform-approximation conditions.
assumptions: The necessary eigenvalue-sum test and average optimizer are not sufficient worst-case accuracy.
Changing P with frequency or leaving the fixed span changes the legal approximation class.
costs: Pay at least the required collective representation dimension within an N-site array; synthesis/calibration and actual passive response resources remain separate.
contract.units: q,W are phase; N,r counts; residual norm epsilon dimensionless, not infidelity.
contract.obstruction: Validate numerical covariance/grid inputs and actual response realization before claiming a specific mode count or gate.

body: Integrating |u><u| over a complete2pi circle gives(2pi/N)I. Positivity bounds the interval integral by this operator, while tracing against P gives W*(1-epsilon^2); combine them. C_I is positive with trace1; KyFan gives the greatest AVERAGE rank-r capture. Its top-r eigenspace need not minimize worst-frequency residual. In centered coordinates ||u_prime||^2=(N^2-1)/12, so a covering uniform M>=2 point grid gives sup e<=max_grid e+sqrt((N^2-1)/12)*W/(2*(M-1)), conditional on trustworthy grid values. A static span is essential; a frequency-dependent full-N response is outside it. r counts representation dimension, not physical emitters or passive poles. Quoted N33/rank5 and other tables require the unavailable numerical eigensystem/grid files and are not independently accepted certificates.
